units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 18:33">Targ. Ps. XVIII, 33</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="S01452"><he>קָמוּר</he></cite>); <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 18:40">ib. 40</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 16:4">Targ. Y. Lev. XVI, 4</cite> (ed. Amst. <cite ref="S01452"><he>קַמּוּרָא</he></cite>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 59b:13">Sabb. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ שרי</he> a woman is permitted to go out on the Sabbath with a (gold) belt.
Ib. ק׳ עילוי וכ׳ how about wearing a ḳamra over a hemyan (v. הֶמְיָין).

<cite ref="Horayot 13b:17">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>נהי דאהני לך ק׳ וכ׳</he> (En Yaaḳ. <cite ref="S00408"><he>קוּמְרָא</he></cite>) because thy father’s (official) belt helped thee to be president of the court, must we make thee Nasi?
